# Three.js

`three.module.min.js` and `three.core.min.js` are the unmodified ES module builds
from the npm package **three@0.180.0**. Both files are needed. Licensed under MIT;
see [THREE-LICENSE.txt](THREE-LICENSE.txt).

These local files let the stadium run without a CDN, package install, or build.
The stadium artwork and animation are procedural in `../stadium3d.js`.
